lines.text: Many learners say: I am not more tired.
Better: I am not tired anymore.
Anymore! I am not tired anymore.

native.tip: Im Deutschen sagen wir „nicht mehr müde“. Im Englischen steht „anymore“ am Ende: „not tired anymore“.
native.caption: Sagen Sie „not more“? 😴 Falsch: “I am not more tired.” Richtig: “I am not tired anymore.” Hören Sie Ama zu und sprechen Sie nach! Mehr üben in der Lexkite-App.

en.tip: German says “nicht mehr müde”. English says “not tired anymore” with “anymore” at the end.
en.caption: “Nicht mehr” is “not anymore”! Wrong: “I am not more tired.” Right: “I am not tired anymore.” Listen to Ama and repeat! Practice more in the Lexkite app.
